name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Accounts linked at SimpleFin after setup can now be mapped from Advanced → Accounts, without re-running setup and losing every other setting. Until now such an account was skipped in silence: the sync reported success, imported nothing from it, and the only evidence was an account that never appeared in Wealthfolio. It also announces itself now — the Overview shows a banner naming any unmapped account, and the companion sends one Telegram notice the first time it sees it. Scheduled Telegram reports retry a momentary network failure instead of losing the whole day's report, and a push to main now build-checks the companion image so a broken build surfaces before release day.
